scope: Four exact source-English row corrections; tentative lexical choices flagged in row notes.

rows.note: The printed line names a bridge; the prior English invented Bakai. Залдуу is provisionally rendered bound; its precise material sense needs lexical review.

rows.previous_en: And a drum with a golden tuft
rows.revised_en: The broad-browed one with a golden crest
rows.note: The printed line describes a golden crest/forelock and broad facial feature; the prior English invented a drum. The exact epithet remains tentative.

rows.previous_en: My child, your nobility is beyond reproach,
rows.revised_en: Has your greatness been put to the test?
rows.note: The source is a second-person question; the previous English introduced my child and recast the question as praise.

rows.revised_en: You stand there without being toppled.
rows.note: The source describes standing without being overturned; the previous English invented an address to a sister-in-law.
